status: Root approved before any final matched benchmark run
purpose: Practical engineering investigation flags, not statistical significance or an automatic release score
required_comparability: Identical fixture geometry, work counts and checksum
Valid uniquely owned pinned browser process scope
Compare covered phase duration and sample timing before interpreting deltas
Keep Chromium browser-only memory distinct from ChromeDriver-inclusive samples
zero_baseline: Use the absolute bound and mark the relative ratio undefined; a positive qualifying idle delta from zero is investigated
coverage: CPU deltas require comparable covered phase duration; sparse or misaligned boundaries are inconclusive until existing raw traces are examined. No invented CPU delta for a single short sample.
memory: RSS sums can double-count shared pages. PSS is a sparse separately sampled process-tree value, not a continuous maximum. Missing PSS remains null.
action: Investigate any concrete flagged regression using existing traces first; repeat only if attribution remains materially uncertain, never automatically. A single boundary or isolated peak sample is not statistical evidence.
Chromium: Descriptive comparison only, with interface and process-scope limitations retained.
paced_elapsed_time: Fixed pacing prevents speed or throughput claims.
